第1487章 地府整风运动（第1页）
“没想到地府居然有如此多的贪财之人？”
西方鬼帝王真人上前一步想要说什么，不过被九凤阻止了。
“不用说你们没有贪污财物，刚才后土娘娘使用圣人之威，扫视了整个地府，谁人身上有多少钱财一清二楚！”
阎罗王已经开始肉疼了，他之前已经被楚云光顾过无数次。
他们名单后面是他们所持有的财物数量。
“这是后土娘娘交给我的，娘娘对你们非常的失望！”
怎么回事？以前圣人不是不管这事吗？当然这是以前，现在圣人需要财富。
“尔等贪污之人，废去法力，然后打入九幽炼狱，永世不得超生。”
北方鬼帝杨云咽了一口唾沫吗？“我等是有错，难道圣人真的打算赶尽杀绝吗？”
他知道现在动手绝对占不了什么便宜。
九凤和后羿都是上古大巫，实力极其强悍。
就算他们有着人数优势也不一定能够占到多少便宜。
“当然，你们这些贪污之人，如果愿意上交七成财富的话，圣人也是可以网开一面的。”
九凤上前一步，贪婪地说道，像极了某人。
面对九凤的威压，阎罗王第1个妥协了。
20年前他的财富早就被楚云连锅端了。
最近几年他攒了一点点，现在就算交出去也不心疼。
虽然不知道发生了什么事情，但是可以肯定，如果他们不交钱的话，后果极其严重。
毕竟之前的圣人神识是做不了假的。
“不过，数量还不够，尔等还需要收缴其他贪污之人的钱财！”
听到九凤的话，在场的众人松了一口气。
只要不是只有他们出钱就可以了，而且这个过程当中，他们甚至还可以再捞一笔。
“收缴其他贪污之人七成的钱财，他们要不交的话，就直接打入十八层地狱。”
然而那些上交财富的人心有不甘，又会揭发检举他人。
…………孙悟空又找到了禁食教派，这帮不嗑药的家伙还算是正常一些。
“几位，你们在这里见过僧人吗？”
一位身穿黑袍的教会成员贪婪地说道。

Chapter 1487 Underworld Rectification Movement (Page 1)
"I didn't expect there to be so many money-grubbing people in the underworld?"
The Western Ghost Emperor took a step forward and wanted to say something, but was stopped by Jiufeng.
"It goes without saying that you have not embezzled property. Just now, Empress Houtu used the power of a saint to scan the entire underworld. It is clear how much money everyone has!"
King Yama has begun to feel pain in his body. He has been patronized by Chu Yun countless times before.
Following their list is the amount of property they hold.
"Empress Houtu gave this to me. I am very disappointed in you!"
What's going on? Didn’t the saints not care about this matter in the past? Of course this was in the past, now saints need wealth.
"You corrupt people will lose your magic power and then be thrown into the Nine Nether Purgatory, where you will never be reincarnated."
Did Yang Yun, the Northern Ghost Emperor, swallow his saliva? "We are wrong. Does the saint really intend to kill everyone?"
He knew that there was absolutely no advantage to be gained by taking action now.
Jiu Feng and Hou Yi are both ancient witches, extremely powerful.
Even if they have a numerical advantage, they may not be able to take advantage.
"Of course, if you corrupt people are willing to hand over 70% of your wealth, the saint can also be lenient."
Jiufeng took a step forward and said greedily, looking very much like someone.
Faced with Jiufeng's pressure, King Yama was the first to compromise.
His wealth had already been taken away by Chu Yun 20 years ago.
He had saved a little bit in the past few years, and now he wouldn't feel bad even if he handed it over.
Although I don't know what happened, I am sure that if they don't pay, the consequences will be extremely serious.
After all, the divine consciousness of the previous saints cannot be faked.
"However, the amount is not enough. You also need to collect the money of other corrupt people!"
After hearing Jiufeng's words, everyone present breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as they are not the only ones paying, they can even make another fortune in the process.
"Collect 70% of other corrupt people's money. If they don't pay, they will be sent directly to the eighteenth level of hell."
However, those who hand over their wealth are unwilling to do so and will expose others.
.........Sun Wukong found the Fasting Sect again. These guys who don't take drugs are relatively normal.
"Guys, have you seen any monks here?"
A church member in black robes said greedily.
